sample_id.description: The sample ID (slice, cell etc.) from which the data is acquired, for naming files. ONLY numbers, letters and +. Ex: 'slice01', 'cell+03'

sample_type.description: Biosample type (as defined by ENCODE Biosample Type).

pathology.description: Describes the pathology of the sample or the type of control. Necessary if different from healthy.

derived_from.description: The sample ID from which the present sample is derived from. Ex: if you record a cell that comes from a slice labeled 'slice01', indicate 'slice01' here!

samples_datafile_path.description: Location of the corresponding samples file (if it exists and/or several samples are used)
